Hunter Rivera’s position as Weld County Chair must be replaced immediately.

We have zero tolerance in the Republican Party for anyone involved in these horrific crimes against children. The Weld County GOP needs to act right now to remove him and send a clear message: our party protects kids and upholds integrity. No excuses. No delays.
